_note: The Last Curtain character art, slices 1 and 2 (2026-11-23). SDXL base 1.0, dpmpp_2m karras, 30 steps, cfg 7, 832 x 1216. Figures are img2img from a pose base (an approved concept figure, mirrored so it turns right) at 'denoise', so the stance, scale and paper match. Positive: subject + ', ' + FIG + ', ' + the mood (WARM for the freed, DREAD for the bound). The bound form is the freed one with the khan tang inpainted (README, 'Blindfold').
FIG: full length figure, standing, feet visible, small in the frame with empty space around, seen in three-quarter view turned to the right side of the picture, plain dim greyish paper background
MED: Vietnamese oil pastel drawing on toned paper, thick waxy smudged strokes, visible paper grain, muted desaturated earth colours, raw umber, ash grey, faded olive, dull deep red accents
WARM: soft lamplight, calm, warm, dignified, quiet, tender
DREAD: dim light, silent, morbid, uncanny, eerie stillness, unsettling, melancholic
NEG: blood, gore, wounds, corpse, skull, close-up, portrait crop, cropped legs, cropped feet, facing the viewer, front view, photo, 3d render, photorealistic face, likeness of a real person, anime, cartoon, chibi, bright saturated colours, text, letters, logo, watermark, frame, border, multiple figures, scenery, jump-scare face, deformed
